name: claudeseo
text: Paying for SEO audit software every month? There's a free, open source plugin for Claude Code. It's called Claude SEO. Give it any website, and it runs a full audit in ten to fifteen minutes. Up to seventeen agents check your site at the same time. Technical SEO, speed, content, schema, and even how likely ChatGPT and Perplexity are to cite you. You get a plan sorted by what matters most, and every fix tells you how to check it worked. It runs on your machine. Comment SEO and I'll send you the link.

name: impeccable6
text: Ever noticed every AI-built website looks the same? Inter font, purple gradients, cards inside cards. Impeccable gives your coding agent the words to fix it. Here are six commands. One: bolder, for designs that play it too safe. Two: quieter tones down loud ones. Three: critique scores your design and ranks what to fix first. Four: audit checks accessibility, speed and mobile layouts. Five: polish, the final pass before you ship. Six: live. Pick an element in your browser and flip through variants. Free and open source. Comment IMPECCABLE and I'll send you the link.

name: openbot
text: Juggling Claude Code, Codex and Grok in five terminal windows? OpenBot puts them all in one desktop app. Every agent gets its own workspace and its own chat, and it sticks around. Line up tasks in a queue you can pause and resume. Agents can message each other and pass files. They can even open and control a built-in browser. Gemini, Cursor and OpenCode work too. It's a development preview, and agents get full access, so only run tasks you trust. Free for non-commercial use. Comment OPENBOT and I'll send you the link.
